automation.description: Signs in as admin in SmartClient (desktop UX/UI) and looks at each DevOps screen with its safe actions: Control Panel, Data Maintenance, Document Creator, Monitoring Dashboard and Heap Dumps. The destructive actions are left to the destructive script.

interaction.name: Control Panel: every tab, a query, cache statistics and generated SAIL
interaction.description: Opens the Control Panel, visits each tab, runs a query, shows the cache statistics, checks that generating SAIL is refused until a UX/UI is chosen, and switches query tracing on and off.

method.comment: A server-wide trace flag: switch it on and back off
GenerateMenuSAIL set the view's selected tab to Results: the check box's rerender keeps the tab the user selected

interaction.name: Data Maintenance: every tab, the backup list and import/export
interaction.description: Opens Data Maintenance, visits its tabs, checks the backup list shows the suite's backups and that selecting a backup enables Delete and Restore, and runs the safe database actions on the Data tab and the audit check, then opens the import/export list.

method.comment: Delete, Download and Restore need a backup selected
SmartClient only: the Data tab's DDL actions only show the DDL; Truncate runs in 99-truncate.xml

interaction.name: Document Creator: write a script and preview it
interaction.description: Opens Document Creator, writes a short script and checks it survives a visit to each preview tab.

interaction.name: Monitoring Dashboard: charts and requests
interaction.description: Opens the Monitoring Dashboard, checks its Refresh buttons are hidden in their closed boxes, and that the Requests tab lists requests.

interaction.name: Heap Dumps (SmartClient only)
interaction.description: Opens Heap Dumps, which only SmartClient offers, and checks Download Heap Dump is disabled until a dump is selected.

method.comment: Nothing in the UI makes a heap dump (the Dump Heap job has no menu item or action), so the list is whatever the server has, and nothing is selected

interaction.name: Document Creator: Submit refused without an output location
interaction.description: Opens Document Creator and presses Submit without an output location, checking it is refused.

method.comment: No script or output location has been entered, so Submit must refuse to run
